correctness.rationale: For each k>=2, G_k is injective and completely multiplicative. For distinct a,b, a prime r not dividing ab makes both ar and br non-k-th-powers because r occurs to exponent 1; hence F_k(ar)=ar differs from F_k(br)=br, proving F_k quasi-injective. Since G_k(n)=n^k always lies in the collapsed set, F_k(G_k(n))=1 for all n, so the composition is not quasi-injective. The supplementary exact-integer verifier returned VERIFY_OK on bounded regression tests.
